corrections.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the TARGET two-action sprite sheet; Image 2 is the approved full-body character baseline, Image 3 its approved face. Make a minimal correction to image 1 ONLY. Preserve both poses, screen-right orientation, all clothing, props, anatomy, head shapes, nose structure and position, facial spacing, composition and transparent background. Correct every open eye into a mathematically ROUND solid-black dot of equal horizontal and vertical diameter, same center and approximate smaller diameter as before. Do not reshape the nose or mouth. Slim the exposed limb SHAFTS to match image 2's thin paired-outline rods, approximately 0.045 of the head width including both outlines, with a clear white interior gap. Keep the same big paws/shoes/hands, same limb lengths, same joints and poses, and head/body sizes. Do not thin the whole body or change head proportions. Keep only two exterior lines per limb, no inner anatomy lines.  No dark or gray shading, no soft shadow or glow around the silhouette. Outer area has clean alpha transparency (not fake black or checkerboard); interiors of shapes stay opaque pure white. Keep all features inside the same image bounds and the central gutter empty. No added objects, captions or text.
